subject.title: fix(codex): keep OpenClaw exec when native surface has no environment (#92238)

question: Should direct/no-sandbox Codex app-server turns with zero execution environments receive OpenClaw's existing `exec` and `process` tools?
rationale: The missing-shell regression and current dependency behavior are established, but choosing the executable-tool owner for this mode is an intentional security-boundary decision.

options.title: Accept focused fallback
options.body: Restore policy-governed OpenClaw shell tools only when Codex has no execution environment, as this PR does.

options.title: Keep native-only ownership
options.body: Leave zero-environment direct turns without shell execution until Codex can provide an environment.

recommendation.title: Accept focused fallback
recommendation.body: Restore policy-governed OpenClaw shell tools only when Codex has no execution environment, as this PR does.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history owns the adjacent sandbox and native shell routing implementation.
